# Mama Earth - Business Narrative
# Source of numbers : narrator/findings.json (written by analysis/clean_and_eda.py)
# Generated by      : OFFLINE FALLBACK - template, not AI-generated
# Generated at      : 2026-10-08 07:51 UTC
# Verified figures  : 7/7 matched

SITUATION
Mama Earth processed 175 clean orders between 2026-01-02 and 2026-06-29, generating INR 97,358.30 in revenue at an average order value of INR 556.33. The overall return rate is 25.14% - roughly one order in four comes back.

COMPLICATION
Returns are not spread evenly. COD orders return at 44.44% while card orders return at only 14.71%, which makes the payment method the single strongest signal in the data. The worst combination is COD orders in Tier-2 cities, returning at 54.55%. Raw revenue (INR 99,860.20) was inflated by INR 2,501.90 of duplicate orders, and two bulk orders masked March as the true peak month (INR 20,318.90).

RESOLUTION
1. Tighten COD: require OTP confirmation or a small prepayment on high-value COD orders, starting with Tier-2 cities where the return rate is highest.
2. Offer a prepaid incentive at checkout so the COD share of orders falls over time.
3. Investigate Milky Soft Baby Lotion (P11), the product with the largest return-linked revenue loss (INR 8,073.00).
4. Report revenue on de-duplicated, outlier-flagged figures so business plans are built on numbers that survive audit.
